rules.title: How quota is counted
rules.1: The free data source allows 5 requests per minute and 500 per day
rules.2: Cached prices up to 15 minutes old are reused without using quota
rules.3: The quota day starts at 07:00 Thailand time
rules.4: When quota runs out or the source does not answer, pages still open using the latest price with a "Data not updated" badge
